rpcSource: async(method,params=[])=>{const r=await fetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:1,method,params}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(120000)});const b=await r.json();if(b.error)throw new Error(JSON.stringify({method,error:b.error}));return b.result;}
submitSource: async(item,label,expectedStatus='0x1',trace=false)=>{const t=item.transaction??item;const envelope={from:t.from,to:t.to,data:t.input??t.data,value:t.value??'0x0',gas:bound,gasPrice:'0x77359400'};const timestamp=item.receipt?.blockTimestamp; if(timestamp!==undefined)await rpc('evm_setNextBlockTimestamp',[Number(timestamp)]);let simulation;try{simulation={ok:true,result:await rpc('eth_call',[envelope,'pending'])};}catch(error){simulation={ok:false,error:String(error)};} const hash=await rpc('eth_sendTransaction',[envelope]);await rpc('evm_mine'); const receipt=await rpc('eth_getTransactionReceipt',[hash]);const transaction=await rpc('eth_getTransactionByHash',[hash]);const block=await rpc('eth_getBlockByNumber',[receipt.blockNumber,false]); const result={label,simulation,transaction,receipt,canonical:block.hash===receipt.blockHash};ownedTransactions.push(result); if(trace)result.trace=await rpc('debug_traceTransaction',[hash,{tracer:'callTracer'}]);if(!result.canonical||receipt.status!==expectedStatus||transaction.gas!==bound)throw new Error('Receipt gate '+JSON.stringify({label,hash,status:receipt.status,gas:transaction.gas}));return result;}
replaySource: async()=>{for(const [i,item] of infra.transactions.entries()){const holder=item.transaction.from.toLowerCase()!==dev;if(holder){if(item.index>=5)throw new Error('Unexpected sender');await rpc('anvil_setBalance',[item.transaction.from,'0x3635c9adc5dea00000']);await rpc('anvil_impersonateAccount',[item.transaction.from]);impersonations.push({address:item.transaction.from,started:true,stopped:false});}try{await submit(item,'infrastructure-'+item.index);}finally{if(holder){await rpc('anvil_stopImpersonatingAccount',[item.transaction.from]);impersonations[impersonations.length-1].stopped=true;}}if((i+1)%25===0)print('BOUNDED_REPLAY',i+1);}print('INFRASTRUCTURE_COMPLETE',ownedTransactions.length);}
